name: @luciola/core
description: Lightweight, resilient LAN peer discovery and interface intelligence for Node.js

scripts.build: cargo build --release -p luciola-node && cp $(cargo metadata --format-version 1 --no-deps | grep -o '"target_directory":"[^"]*' | cut -d '"' -f 4)/release/libluciola_node.dylib ./luciola.node
scripts.test: node test.js && node test/forward.test.mjs && node test/contract.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npx --yes -p typescript@5 tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target es2020 --module commonjs test/api-consumer.ts
